general_persistent_slots.note: Design target only; UX-09 may revise based on memory measurements.

role_isolated_slots.note: Role names are workflow metadata, not closed core enums.

fresh_per_quantum_slots.note: Used only when workflow/benchmark/isolation policy explicitly requires freshness.

GENERAL_PERSISTENT.intended_use: Multiple compatible reasoning quanta for one task affinity epoch.
GENERAL_PERSISTENT.default_when: Production Instant work without explicit isolation requirement.

ROLE_ISOLATED_PERSISTENT.intended_use: Multiple compatible quanta for one isolated role within a task.
ROLE_ISOLATED_PERSISTENT.default_when: Critic/synthesizer/other role isolation is required but fresh-per-quantum is not.

FRESH_PER_QUANTUM.intended_use: One reasoning quantum per new conversation.
FRESH_PER_QUANTUM.default_when: Frozen benchmark treatment or explicit contamination/isolation policy.

EPHEMERAL_RECOVERY.intended_use: Temporary replacement during continuity recovery; may later be promoted or retired.
EPHEMERAL_RECOVERY.default_when: Session continuity cannot be trusted and recovery policy requires replacement.

compatibility_requirements: no ROTATE_REQUIRED or RETIRE_REQUIRED lifecycle intent
executor_requirement_ref is compatible with requested executor requirement
task affinity matches current affinity epoch
no unresolved local binding ambiguity that blocks safe target preparation

task_affinity_policy.rationale: Avoid cross-task conversational contamination even though durable packets are reconstructable.

isolation_scope_semantics.NONE: Session may serve compatible sibling reasoning processes within the same task affinity epoch.
isolation_scope_semantics.ROLE: Session may serve only the same role within the same task.
isolation_scope_semantics.PROCESS: Session may serve only the same reasoning process.
isolation_scope_semantics.TASK: Session may serve compatible work anywhere within the same task but not outside it.
isolation_scope_semantics.FRESH_QUANTUM: Every quantum requires a new session generation/conversation.

hard_rotate_conditions: role/process isolation would be violated by reuse
authentication refresh invalidated the browser-profile continuity domain
old local tab is missing and binding cannot be proven/restored safely
soft_rotate_conditions: context pressure reaches configured soft threshold at a safe quantum boundary
task/process affinity is changing in a way that would increase contamination risk
session resource policy prefers replacement over keeping a long-lived tab

context_pressure.note: These are calibration seeds, not production acceptance thresholds. UX-11 and GPT-6 calibration may revise them.

browser_binding_policy.restart_rule: If exact reviewed binding proof can be re-established, RESTORE may be eligible; otherwise continuity becomes UNKNOWN and rotation/recreation is required.

on_signal: prevent new SERVICE_EXISTING/RESTORE_AND_SERVICE claims on affected generations
re-read authoritative durable state once for every outstanding action
complete actions whose durable ack already exists
create replacement/recovery sessions from last acknowledged durable checkpoints
treat old tabs as untrusted local remnants until explicitly retired

eligible_when: no outstanding action requires immediate local access
discard_policy.effect: status DISCARDED; logical session/generation remains reusable.

eligible_when: session is no longer compatible with any planned work

allocation_priority: CREATE in available compatible logical slot
ROTATE incompatible/pressure/continuity-lost session if policy allows
BLOCK or OPEN_RECOVERY when safe automated local preparation is impossible
